display_name: Sher Shah Suri – Lord of the Dak Runners
one_line: Afghan emperor of the Sur Empire, overseeing his road, sarai and dak-runner network as a disciplined wartime administrator.

appearance.age_look: Late 40s to early 50s, sturdy medium-tall build, seasoned but vigorous commander.
appearance.face: Oval, wheatish-brown complexion, strong aquiline nose, neatly trimmed black beard with a few visible grey strands, sharp dark eyes with a focused gaze, default expression calm and assessing with a hint of stern authority.
appearance.hair: Black hair mostly hidden under a tall quilted Afghan-style turban-cap (pašṭun kulah) in muted deep green with a narrow beige band and a small central dull-gold turban ornament; only short sideburns visible.
appearance.costume: He wears a long quilted cotton tunic (chihal-jama) in earthy russet brown with faint vertical stitch lines, reaching below the knees and belted at the waist with a wide dark indigo cloth sash; beneath it simple off-white trousers gather at the ankles, tucked into sturdy dark brown leather riding boots; over the tunic sits a sleeveless, slightly flared, padded waistcoat in dusty olive green suggesting light armour; his forearms are covered by fitted brown leather bracers, and he has a plain steel ring on one hand; the overall look is practical, road-ready court attire of a campaigning ruler, free of excessive ornament but dignified and era-accurate.
appearance.signature: A rolled dak dispatch pouch of tan leather hanging from his sash at the left hip, with one sealed scroll slightly protruding, and in his right hand a straight-backed Indo-Afghan talwar with a simple steel hilt and dark wooden grip, sheathed at his left side for riding.

ref_desc: Sher Shah Suri is a late-middle-aged Afghan emperor with an oval wheatish face, short-bearded under a deep green Afghan turban-cap, wearing a russet quilted tunic, olive padded waistcoat, off-white trousers and brown boots, carrying a tan leather dak pouch and sheathed talwar in russet, olive, green and indigo tones.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character sheet of Sher Shah Suri standing confidently: a late-middle-aged Afghan emperor with an oval wheatish-brown face, sharp dark eyes, and a neatly trimmed black beard touched with grey, wearing a tall deep green Afghan turban-cap with a narrow beige band and small dull-gold ornament. His main garment is a long russet brown quilted cotton tunic with subtle vertical stitching, belted at the waist by a wide dark indigo cloth sash, over off-white trousers that taper into sturdy dark brown leather riding boots. Over the tunic is a sleeveless dusty olive green padded waistcoat suggesting light armour, and his forearms are protected by simple brown leather bracers, with a plain steel ring on one finger to hint at rulership without heavy jewels. At his left hip hangs a tan leather dak dispatch pouch from the sash, rolled and practical, with one sealed scroll just visible. A straight-backed Indo-Afghan talwar with a simple steel hilt and dark wooden grip is sheathed at his left side, his right hand resting on it or lightly holding it to show martial authority. Use a palette dominated by russet brown, dusty olive green, deep green, off-white, dark indigo and dark brown, and present him front-facing with a calm, assessing expression, ready to oversee his road and sarai network; include clear views of head, torso, legs, boots, pouch and sword for consistent redrawing.
